svg.desc: ТПТС АВР комбинированный для Dull Screen

rt:param.name: KKS
rt:param.comment: KKS общий для ТЕ и VL

rt:var.name: MyStrokeWdth
rt:var.comment: Толщина рамок в зависимости от управляемости

rt:var.name: AckSupport
rt:var.comment: Фиктивная переменная, означающая, что данный объект поддерживает самоквитирование по функции AckMe()

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub AckMe() If Check_Oper_Rights(TE_OU) && ((TE_OU.PVSuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) == 0) && ((AStat & 1) != 0) Then TE_OU.Command(_Now, TE_BHA) End If End Sub

Sub ShText() StatusTE = PRJSPEC.TPTS_TE(KKS + "TE0", 3, 2, Col, AStat) If (StatusTE == -1)Then SText = "РЕМ." ElseIf ((StatusTE & 4096) > 0) Then SText = "НДСТ" ElseIf ((StatusTE & 0x30) > 0) Then SText = "АВТ" ElseIf ((StatusTE & 0xC) > 0) Then SText = "ДИСТ" Else SText = "???" End If End Sub

Sub ComplexRights() If Change_Frame_on_Oper Then If (IsOperable(Operate, TE_OU) & IsOperable(Operate, TE_OU) & 2) != 0 Then MyStrokeWdth = 3 Else MyStrokeWdth = 1 End If Else MyStrokeWdth = 2 End If End Sub

Sub Show_Selection() If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col1, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_1.font_size = 17 text_1.font_weight = "bold" text_1.text_decoration = "underline" text_1.fill = "black" Else text_1.font_size = 14 text_1.font_weight = "normal" text_1.text_decoration = "none" text_1.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col2, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_2.font_size = 17 text_2.font_weight = "bold" text_2.text_decoration = "underline" text_2.fill = "black" Else text_2.font_size = 14 text_2.font_weight = "normal" text_2.text_decoration = "none" text_2.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col3, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_3.font_size = 17 text_3.font_weight = "bold" text_3.text_decoration = "underline" text_3.fill = "black" Else text_3.font_size = 14 text_3.font_weight = "normal" text_3.text_decoration = "none" text_3.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If (KKS != "NULL") Then TE_Z0 = BIN(KKS + "TE0_Z0") TE_OU = BIN(KKS + "TE0_OU") TE_VB7 = BIN(KKS + "TE0_VB7") VL_Z0 = BIN(KKS + "VL0_Z0") VL_OU = BIN(KKS + "VL0_OU") VL_VB6 = BIN(KKS + "VL0_VB6") End If
Al_frame.x = 2.5 Al_frame.y = 2.5 Al_frame.width = _This.width - 5 Al_frame.height = _This.height - 5 InGr.x = 0 InGr.y = 0 InGr.width = _This.width InGr.height = _This.height

rt:changeTrigger.name: GetStatus_VL
